summary: Patient forgot the appointment because no reminder message was received; requested rebooking for next week.
recommended_action: Verify patient notification preferences and ensure automated SMS/call reminders are enabled, then reschedule the visit.

summary: Patient lives far away, lacked morning transport, and considers the clinic too distant for routine check-ups.
recommended_action: Offer telehealth/virtual consultation options for routine visits or assist with community transit resources.

summary: Patient skipped due to consultation cost concerns and inquired about follow-up discounts.
recommended_action: Provide information regarding sliding-scale fees, discounted follow-up packages, or payment plans.
Initiate follow-up contact with the patient to ascertain the reason for absence and document feedback.

summary: Patient was bedridden with high fever and body ache, intending to visit after recovery.
recommended_action: Check patient recovery status via follow-up call and reschedule once symptoms subside.

summary: Patient had an urgent workplace meeting and requested evening appointment availability.
recommended_action: Reschedule the patient to an evening or extended-hours clinic slot as requested.

summary: Patient forgot the visit due to not receiving an SMS reminder and requested rebooking.
recommended_action: Confirm mobile contact details, verify SMS delivery configuration, and rebook the appointment.

summary: Patient could not travel due to a city bus strike, lack of auto-rickshaws, and general distance from the clinic.
recommended_action: Explore telemedicine consultation or schedule future visits during non-disrupted transit periods.

summary: Clinic staff could not reach the patient across three attempts because the phone was switched off.
recommended_action: Send an alternative outreach message (email or postal communication) and request an alternate contact number upon next touchpoint.

summary: Patient experienced a factory shift change preventing leave, and expressed preference for Saturday slots.
recommended_action: Reschedule the patient for a Saturday clinic session to accommodate their work schedule.
